proposalRequirements: ELIP submitted on forum.eigenlayer.xyz. Only the Protocol Council (3-of-5 Safe) and Operations Multisig (3-of-6 Safe) can queue upgrades through the primary Timelock. The Operations Multisig also holds the CANCELLER_ROLE and can cancel Protocol Council proposals.
votingProcess: ELIP discussion → Protocol Council (3/5) approves → queued in primary Timelock → 10-day delay → execute. Ops Multisig can cancel.
